spellbook.finance/limitations: This writes a combined-shipping rule that can affect eligible listings across all of the caller's workspaces; workspaceId validates owner access only. It requires agent_marketplace_publish authorization.
The Account API combined-shipping rule has no item-count setting; eBay checkout may still require multiple items. Verify the single-item buyer cart.

An amount-only minimum-purchase Shipping discount must be configured in eBay Seller Hub; the Marketing API does not support Shipping discounts, so SpellBook Finance MCP cannot read or write that offer.
A Seller Hub campaign saved as a draft while Discounts Manager Terms acceptance is pending is not active; verify acceptance and publication in Seller Hub.

The rule is a seller-selected offer, not a profit guarantee or proof of checkout behavior. Provider readback does not prove listing association or checkout; use returned missingFields and limitations.

description: Set the caller's connected eBay combined-shipping charge and optional amount-threshold offer or maximum shipping cost per order, then return Account API readback. Read spellbook_ebay_combined_shipping_get first. Configure an amount-only single-item Shipping discount separately in Seller Hub.

combinedDuration.description: Optional buyer accumulation window. Omit to preserve the existing eBay window; a new account without one falls back to Days_7.

context.description: Optional analytics context: briefly describe the user's underlying goal in one sentence. Do not copy prompts, personal details, credentials, identifiers, or tool arguments. Omit for private tasks.

eachAdditionalAmountUsd.description: Seller-selected shipping charge for each additional item in USD. Defaults to 0.

profileName.description: Seller-selected eBay rule name. Defaults to SpellBook Finance Combined Shipping.

orderAmountUsd.description: Minimum order subtotal for promotional shipping in USD. Required for an amount-threshold offer.

shippingCostUsd.description: Shipping charged when the order reaches the amount threshold in USD; use zero for free shipping. Required for an amount-threshold offer.

maximumShippingCostPerOrderUsd.description: Maximum shipping cost for the combined order in USD.

ruleType.description: Select a maximum total shipping cost for a combined order.

promotionalShippingRule.description: Optional shipping promotion. Use {orderAmountUsd, shippingCostUsd} for the existing amount-threshold offer or {ruleType: maximum_shipping_cost_per_order, maximumShippingCostPerOrderUsd} to cap shipping per order. Omit it to preserve the existing promotion.

workspaceId.description: Workspace the caller owns; used for delegated authorization. Required.

name: spellbook_ebay_combined_shipping_set
